title: Graft pack manifest
description: A graft is a portable pack of practices and data-only evidence from outside a loop. It carries no authority: every claim must be re-validated by the importing loop's own correctness gate and adversarial verifier. The manifest is structurally closed (additionalProperties: false) so authority, capability, threshold, and score fields cannot be declared by a pack at all.

pack.description: Stable pack id, lowercase kebab/snake case.

title.description: Human-readable pack name. Length is enforced by the intake script; this schema subset does not check maxLength.

description.description: One paragraph: what the pack argues and for whom. Length is enforced by the intake script.

license.description: SPDX identifier. A pack must be redistributable or it cannot be indexed or installed.

authors.description: Attribution only; authorship carries no trust.

ref.description: The ref the pack was authored against. Intake records the resolved commit separately; pins are always commit SHAs.

path.description: Pack-root-relative, forward slashes, no '..'. The intake script rejects absolute paths, escapes, symlinks, and hidden files.

bytes.description: Content length; the intake script enforces the per-file cap.

kind.description: skill-doc and runbook-doc are prose; fixture-data must be a JSON document. Packs never ship executable content or scoring code.
Closed enum owned by this schema. Consumers map claim kinds to their own gate classes; an unmapped kind must fail closed.

statement.description: The falsifiable claim, in one sentence. Length is enforced by the intake script.

fixtures.description: Artifact paths of kind fixture-data that evidence the claim. regression_test_distinguishes and metric_delta claims require at least one fixture.

conflicts.description: Free-text supersedes/duplicates hints for humans. Nothing in this kit acts on them mechanically.
